svg.title: Banneret — passive tree, clusters
svg.desc: One passive tree shared by the party, laid out as clusters whose node arrangement draws a shape hinting at its effect, with plain paths and empty space between them. Each hero starts beside his portrait and forks out to his own four classes; heroes meet only through mechanic clusters on their borders. Only the selected hero's nodes and paths are shown. Each hero has four class clusters: berserker claw marks, reaver chalice, paladin shield, spellblade sword, wizard spiral, druid leaf, priest sun, warlock pentagram, hexblade eye, duelist crossed blades, assassin flask, ranger arrow. Each class cluster ends in its class keystone, which leads to three small ascension clusters. Mechanic clusters sit between classes: a blood drop for bleed between berserker and ranger, a flame for fire, a crescent for curses, a banner, a ward and haste chevrons. Node colour codes the mechanic. Sample mid-run with the warrior selected. Names, counts and allocations are illustrative. Static SVG mockup.
svg.text: LAYOUT TEST · mid-run sample. Each cluster's shape hints at its effect. Node colour = mechanic. Names, node counts and allocations are illustrative.
Only the selected hero's nodes and paths are shown; pick another hero above to see his. Heroes meet only through the clusters on their borders.
Red: bleed, stagger, banners · Yellow: seals, renew · Blue: channeling, fire, ward · Green: poison, combo, haste · Purple: blood magic, curses · Grey: forms
